topic: What to say when your teen says 'I'm bored' (script included)
caption:
Next time your teen says 'I'm bored,' try this script.

Say: 'Want to make some real money this week? I found something that shows you how step by step.'

That one sentence has launched more than a few teens into their first side hustle.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
